A '''battle''' was fought in the [[Denon system/Legends|Denon system]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], in [[3996 BBY]]. The two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Denon system makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
